intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Somewhere nearby, a crowd bursts into clapping. Tavri is halfway into a bow before she stops.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Ignore that. My spine bows on its own. Beautifully trained, no idea what for.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “No idea. Could be a christening. Could be a goat.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The clapping swells. Her tail sweeps once, politely, in its direction.

options.labelText: “Honestly? Let’s stay right here and find out if it’s the goat.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Standing still while people clap. How wildly rebellious.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: It is the goat. The goat doesn’t bow either.

options.labelText: “Go on, take a bow. Maybe it’s for you.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She sweeps into a full court bow. The clapping falters. Someone holds up a goat.

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Her ears stay flat for some time afterward.
